text:
jen_infra: heads up — provisioning in us-central1 is hitting a storm. lots of GPU attaches stuck in 'creating' and node logs show local NVMe qdepth spikes + metadata checksum errors right after a control-plane heartbeat hiccup.

sam_ops: yup, saw a ~3m window where attach controllers retried. trace attach_id=att-4af2, attach attempt stuck at stage 'allocate_local' repeatedly.

priya_sre: any chance the nightly cleaner overlapped with the control-plane lag? I see a janitor run start at 02:03:11 UTC for pool ephemeral-3.

alex_plat: appears so — cleaner concurrency (default 8) started evicting/prefetching while raft leader changed. snippet from node kernel: 
```
kernel: nvme0: metadata checksum mismatch at block 0x3f2a
storage: read_retries=3 qdepth=512 fsyncs=hundreds/sec
```

miguel: SMART shows a small cohort with rising reallocated sectors but nothing catastrophic. still, the IO pattern plus heavy metadata churn seems to provoke checksum errors on a few drives.

lila: cost/ops note — this spiked GPU provisioning latency and triggered on-demand fallback for about 12% of scheduled jobs in that 00:02–00:06 window. customers may see tail latency increase. :grimacing: 

priya_sre: mitigation suggestion: 1) throttle janitor on impacted pools (concurrency=1), 2) introduce leader-aware cleaner scheduling, 3) cap per-node fsync concurrency. who can push a canary?

sam_ops: pushing small rollbackable change to reduce cleaner concurrency to 1 for ephemeral-3 and ephemeral-4. command: `kubectl set env ds/janitor CLEANER_CONCURRENCY=1 --record` — rolling now.

infra-bot: Deploy started by sam_ops at 1778889999 — namespace=infra, target=janitor-canary, strategy=rolling.

jen_infra: after the throttle, attach success rate returned to baseline in ~90s on affected nodes. repeatable mitigation confirmed on the canary.

alex_plat: I'll create a follow-up: (A) leader-aware janitor lock, (B) adaptive qdepth backpressure in the attach path, (C) fsync concurrency cap per NVMe. also proposing a postmortem doc.

miguel: I'll add storage telemetry (qdepth, metadata errors, reallocated sectors) to the SRE dashboard and set an alert for checksum mismatch rate > 1/min.

jen_infra: good. next steps: open postmortem, plan a scheduler change to avoid janitor/leader overlap, and run small soak test with reduced cleaner concurrency for 48h. tagging oncall. :eyes:

lila: +1 on the postmortem. I'll capture the cost bump numbers and affected customer list after the window.

priya_sre: thanks everyone. filing the ticket and adding required action items.
